Class TransactionHistory

java.lang.Object
bank.reporting.TransactionHistory
public class TransactionHistory extends Object
============================================================================ TransactionHistory.java Owner: John (smartdude879@gmail.com) ============================================================================ ROLE: Searches and filters a customer's transactions, then prints results. SUPPORTED FILTERS (all optional — null means "no filter"): - date range (from / to, inclusive) - account ID (limit to one account) - type (DEPOSIT, WITHDRAW, FEE, INTEREST, ...) - min / max amount - description keyword (case-insensitive substring match) Results are always in chronological order (oldest first). USAGE: TransactionHistory th = new TransactionHistory(); List<Transaction> results = th.search(customer, new SearchCriteria() .type(TransactionType.WITHDRAW) .minAmount(new BigDecimal("100.00"))); th.print(customer, criteria, results); ============================================================================
